inputs.story: The local aerophobe (one with a fear of flying) support group has several members who each need to take a flight. Match each aerophobe to their flight date and destination, and determine what "lucky charm" each intends to bring with them. Remember, as with all grid-based logic puzzles, no option in any category will ever be used more than once.
inputs.constraints:
1. Of Sophie and Gwen, one will bring their rabbit's foot and the other will leave in January.
2. Sophie will leave sometime before Gwen.
3. The passenger with the lucky hat, Gwen and Sophie are all different fliers.
4. Florence will leave 2 months after the passenger with the lucky hat.
5. The passenger leaving in April is either Gwen or the passenger with the talisman.

months: January; February; March; April.
fliers: Florence; Gwen; Olive; Sophie.
lucky charms: coin; lucky hat; rabbit's foot; talisman.
